The SVD phonon analysis reduces the number of modes to consider for phonon engineering while retaining the essential physical information which is validated with inelastic neutron scattering. This analysis shows that even the most significant PM for the selected molecules contribute at most 12-45% of the total dynamic disorder. That is, for none of the selected molecules is a single OM responsible for a large proportion of the dynamic disorder. Our results also identify the collective detrimental motions for charge transport by producing atomic displacement visualizations that reveal which atomic and molecular motions contribute to dynamic disorder. Finally, side-chain effects are probed by SVD phonon analysis; these are not usually considered in detail because the electronic coupling is carried exclusively by the conjugated backbone. Our results show that side-chain location and branching can alter the distribution of backbone vibrational states, harden high-energy backbone-involved motions, and couple side-chain motions to backbone dynamics, thereby indirectly affecting the extent of dynamic disorder. All of this supports the conclusion that SVD phonon analysis could be used as a robust phonon engineering tool to eliminate or generate specific features in a phonon spectrum, generating personalized design rules for next-generation OSCs.
items.authors: Chen-Wei Chiang, Toulik Maitra, Jeremy K. Mason, Adam J. Moulé
items.title_zh: 确定哪些声子影响分子晶体的动态无序和电荷迁移
items.summary_zh: 有机半导体（OSCs），尤其是分子晶体，展现出独特的结构复杂性以及电子与振动自由度之间的强耦合。强电子-声子耦合（EPC）使电荷载流子局域化，并因动态无序（σij）限制电荷传输速率。虽然理论上可以设计出动态无序降低的新型分子晶体，但确定哪些声子对动态无序贡献最大及其对电荷传输的影响一直难以捉摸。本文提出使用奇异值分解（SVD）研究分子晶体中的声子模式，通过将原始声子模式（OMs）转化为影响EPC的排名投影模式（PMs）来实现。SVD声子分析减少了声子工程中需考虑的模式数量，同时保留了重要的物理信息，并通过非弹性中子散射进行了验证。分析结果表明，即使是对所选分子最显著的PM，其对总动态无序的贡献也最多为12-45%。即，对于所选的分子，没有单一的OM对动态无序负有较大责任。我们的结果还通过原子位移可视化识别了对电荷传输有害的集体运动。

items.title: Controlling polyethylene fibrillation in PFAS-free dry electrodes for processability and electrochemical performance
items.abstract: Ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) is a more sustainable binder alternative to polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) for producing PFAS-free Li-ion battery electrodes using a solvent-free PE fibrillation process. We show that PE fibrillation is thermo-activated and can be controlled to produce an extensive network of nano-fibrils with a median size of 20-40 nm. PE-containing graphite electrode ultimate tensile strength (UTS), critical for roll-to-roll processing, improved more than 20-fold when the electrode calendering temperature increased from 100 to 160-200 °C, providing mechanical stability superior to equivalent PTFE-containing electrodes. PE-containing electrodes calendered at lower temperatures (120-140 °C) showed comparable charging rate performance but superior capacity retention of ∼90% after 100 cycles when compared with PTFE-containing electrodes. Removing PTFE by calcination to mimic direct recycling required temperatures 600 °C and led to PFAS emissions. In contrast, PE removal was PFAS-free and achieved at 300-400 °C, aided by the catalytic effect of graphite on PE decomposition making PE-containing electrodes more suitable with direct recycling. Overall, integrating across fabrication, mechanical, electrochemical and end-of-life considerations, PE-containing electrodes offer significant potential for more sustainable solvent-free Li-ion batteries.
items.authors: Guillaume Matthews, Benjamin Meyer, Noël Hallemans, Wenjia Du, Paul Shearing, Patrick S. Grant
items.title_zh: 控制无PFAS干电极中聚乙烯纤维化以提升加工性和电化学性能
items.summary_zh: 超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE）作为无PFAS锂离子电池电极的可持续粘合剂替代聚四氟乙烯（PTFE），采用无溶剂的PE纤维化工艺。研究表明，PE纤维化是热激活的，可以控制生成中位尺寸为20-40纳米的纳米纤维网络。当电极压延温度从100°C提高到160-200°C时，含PE的石墨电极的极限抗拉强度（UTS）提高了20倍以上，提供了优于相应PTFE电极的机械稳定性。压延温度较低（120-140°C）的PE电极在充电速率性能上表现相当，但在100个循环后容量保持率约为90%，优于PTFE电极。通过600°C的焙烧去除PTFE模拟直接回收会导致PFAS排放，而PE的去除在300-400°C下进行，无PFAS排放，石墨对PE分解的催化作用使得含PE电极更适合直接回收。综合考虑制造、机械、电化学及生命周期，含PE电极在无溶剂锂离子电池中具有显著的可持续潜力。

items.title: Fractal Colonization of Prebiotic Niches: Mechanical Budding of Nano-vesicles and Kinetic Resource Depletion as an Oncological Atavism
items.abstract: Periodic mechanical forcing of the early Earth, from lunar tides (period of about 10 h) and radiogenic geysers (about 15 min) to von Kármán vortex shedding (about 1 s), may have loaded fatty-acid protocell membranes on time scales comparable to their relaxation times. We present a minimal model in which the tension of a parent vesicle, relaxing with time constant τ under rectified periodic forcing, releases one nano-vesicle at each upward crossing of a budding threshold. The shed nano-vesicles deplete the free fatty-acid pool of the surrounding niche through a non-linear sink bounded by the critical micelle concentration (CMC). The depletion equation has an exact solution between shedding events, and numerical integration with illustrative parameters shows that the discrete, tension-gated release produces a staircase of quasi-steady monomer levels that the pool follows towards the CMC. We discuss a matching window fτ = O(1) as a possible paleophysical selection criterion and, as a hypothesis not tested here, an analogy with vesicle-mediated nutrient competition in tumour niches.
items.authors: Peter Mikuláš

items.title: Ferrier Rearrangement Intermediates Featuring Aliphatic Acyl Protecting Groups
items.abstract: The Ferrier rearrangement of 1,2-unsaturated monosaccharides (glycals) to 2,3-unsatured glycosides, is important for the synthesis of pharmaceuticals and natural products. Mechanistically, the nucleophilic substitution proceeds via a cationic intermediate, the “Ferrier cation”, whose structure is difficult to capture with conventional analytical techniques. Here, we characterize the Ferrier cations of glucal and galactal building blocks involving aliphatic acyl protecting groups (pivaloyl-, levulinoyl- and chloroacetyl esters) using cryogenic gas-phase infrared spectroscopy. Comparing experimental and computed spectra of candidate structures, we established that all intermediates are stabilized by interactions of the C4 acyl protecting group with the C3 carbon of the pyranose ring (neighboring participation), potentially steering the stereochemical outcome of the Ferrier rearrangement. The resulting C4-C3-dioxolenium ion structure appears to be general to aliphatic acyl protecting groups, contributing to our fundamental understanding of Ferrier rearrangement reactions.
items.authors: Niklas Geue, Kim Greis, Sabrina Omoregbee-Leichnitz, Carla Kirschbaum, Julinton Sianturi, Shenchuang Wang
items.title_zh: 含脂肪族酰基保护基的Ferrier重排中间体研究
items.summary_zh: 1,2-不饱和单糖（糖醇）的Ferrier重排反应生成2,3-不饱和糖苷，对药物和天然产物的合成至关重要。该反应机制中，亲核取代通过阳离子中间体“Ferrier阳离子”进行，其结构难以用传统分析技术捕捉。本文利用低温气相红外光谱对含脂肪族酰基保护基（如pivaloyl、levulinoyl和chloroacetyl酯）的glucal和galactal构建块的Ferrier阳离子进行了表征。通过比较实验和计算的候选结构光谱，我们发现所有中间体均通过C4酰基保护基与吡喃环C3碳的相互作用（邻近参与）得到稳定，这可能影响Ferrier重排的立体化学结果。最终得到的C4-C3-二噁烯离子结构对脂肪族酰基保护基具有普遍性，增进了我们对Ferrier重排反应的基础理解。

items.title: Understanding Differential Chemical Activities of Eutectic Gallium Indium (eGaIn) Thin Films with Fluorinated Analytes using Raman Spectroscopy
items.abstract: Gallium oxide (Ga2O3) forms on the surface of eutectic gallium indium (eGaIn) alloy in air; In the presence of water, it transforms to gallium oxide monohydroxide, GaO(OH). During such transformation, it is challenging to differentiate the activities of the oxides while adsorbing solutes from the solvent. Herein, we address this challenge by investigating the temporal evolution of eGaIn thin films during adsorption of dilute organofluorines in water. We identify five hours as the stability threshold to obtain a water-modified thin film. Leveraging both fresh and five-hour-modified films in parallel, we distinguish water-specific changes and differentiate the signals uniquely caused by fluorinated analytes. The modified GaO(OH) interface demonstrates increased hydrophilicity for microdroplet studies and structural stability under high-energy (20 kV) electron beam irradiation. We leverage Frontier Molecular Orbital (FMO) theory to predict that the GaO(OH) surface is also a reactive catalytic interface. In the presence of the GaO(OH) surface and UVA irradiation, short-chain (HFBA) and long-chain (PFOA) fluorinated compounds exhibited altered interfacial activity. We leveraged Raman spectroscopy throughout our study to differentiate the in situ activities of Ga2O3 and GaO(OH). Our investigations will be useful for differentiating fresh and modified oxide dynamics during in situ interfacial studies or wet chemical measurements.
items.authors: Dechassa Terefe, Muhammad Shamim Al Mamun, Momena Monwar, Md. Tasmirul Jalil, Ryan C. Tung, M. Rashed Khan
items.title_zh: 利用拉曼光谱研究共晶镓铟薄膜的化学活性
items.summary_zh: 在空气中，共晶镓铟（eGaIn）合金表面形成氧化镓（Ga2O3）；在水的存在下，它转变为氢氧化镓（GaO(OH)）。在这一转变过程中，区分氧化物在吸附溶质时的活性具有挑战性。本文通过研究稀释有机氟化物在水中吸附过程中eGaIn薄膜的时间演变，解决了这一挑战。我们确定五小时为获得水改性薄膜的稳定阈值。通过并行利用新鲜和五小时改性薄膜，我们区分了水特异性变化，并识别了氟化分析物引起的独特信号。改性GaO(OH)界面在微滴研究中表现出更强的亲水性，并在高能（20 kV）电子束辐照下具有结构稳定性。我们利用前沿分子轨道（FMO）理论预测GaO(OH)表面也是一个反应性催化界面。在GaO(OH)表面和UVA辐照下，短链（HFBA）和长链（PFOA）氟化化合物表现出改变的界面活性。我们在整个研究中利用拉曼光谱区分了Ga2O3和GaO(OH)的原位活性。我们的研究将有助于区分原始和改性氧化物在原位过程中的动态。

items.title: Exploration of Structure–Activity Relationships and Gut Restriction in Anti-Cryptosporidium Triazolopyridazine Series
items.abstract: Cryptosporidiosis is a major cause of diarrheal disease worldwide, particularly in young children and immunocompromised individuals, yet effective therapeutic options remain limited. Previously, the triazolopyridazine derivative SLU-10482 was identified as a potent anti-Cryptosporidium lead, but it suffers from modest affinity for the hERG ion channel. In the present study, structure–activity relationships (SAR) were investigated through systematic modification of the 3-position of the aryl ring and by designing gutrestricted analogues intended to reduce systemic exposure while maintaining antiparasitic activity. A diverse library of analogues was synthesized using amide coupling, Sonogashira, Suzuki, and Buchwald–Hartwig cross-coupling reactions, followed by hydrogenation and late-stage functional group transformations to access alkynyl, alkyl, tertiary amine, quaternary ammonium, and substituted aryl derivatives. Compounds were evaluated for anti-Cryptosporidium parvum activity in infected HCT-8 cells. SAR studies revealed that smaller, less polar substituents at the 3-position were generally associated with improved potency, whereas increasing substituent size and polarity resulted in diminished activity, although several larger polar analogues retained measurable potency. To develop gut-restricted agents, molecular weight, polarity, and conformational flexibility were intentionally increased to reduce intestinal permeability and systemic exposure. While these modifications were expected to preserve local intestinal activity, the resulting analogues exhibited substantially reduced antiparasitic potency. Because the molecular target of this chemotype remains unknown, the observed loss of activity may arise from reduced target engagement, impaired penetration across the parasite membrane barriers, or a combination of both.
items.authors: Antonio Giardina, Caitlin E. Hamill, Gregory M. Giovine, José Teixeira, Edmund Oboh, Soumitra Guin
items.title_zh: 抗隐孢子虫三唑吡啶并噁唑系列的结构-活性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 隐孢子虫病是全球主要的腹泻病因，尤其在幼儿和免疫受损者中更为严重，然而有效的治疗选择仍然有限。研究发现三唑吡啶并噁唑衍生物SLU-10482为有效的抗隐孢子虫先导化合物，但其对hERG离子通道的亲和力较低。本研究通过系统性修改芳环3位的取代基，探讨了结构-活性关系（SAR），并设计了肠道限制性类似物以降低全身暴露，同时保持抗寄生虫活性。合成了多样的类似物库，并评估其在感染HCT-8细胞中的抗隐孢子虫parvum活性。SAR研究表明，3位较小、极性较低的取代基通常与增强的效力相关，而增大取代基的大小和极性则导致活性降低，尽管一些较大极性类似物仍保留可测量的效力。

items.title: Chiral Patterning Drives Peptide Coacervate Formation in Coarse-Grained SIRAH Simulations
items.abstract: Peptide-based polyelectrolyte complexes (PECs) are a promising class of stimuli-responsive materials with applications in drug delivery. Yet, the molecular mechanism by which stereochemical patterning governs their phase behavior remains unresolved. Racemic chiral patterning is known to favor liquid coacervate formation over solid precipitation by disrupting the ordered β-sheet structure, but experimentally elucidating the molecular-level origin of the solution-phase selection remains challenging. Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics simulations offer a practical route to accessing the time and length scales relevant to coacervate phase behavior but require force fields that capture sequence-dependent structural propensities. One of them is chirality, a capability that has not previously been validated for peptide-based PEC systems. Here, we expand the SIRAH CG force field for modeling chirally and hydrophobically patterned peptide-based PEC systems. By introducing D-chiral dihedral parameters, achieved by inverting the phase angles of the SIRAH backbone torsion potential, we simulate both racemic and homochiral variants of six model PEC systems and compare the results to microsecond atomistic C36m simulations and published FTIR secondary structure data. The racemic SIRAH model reproduces atomistic trends in peptide compaction, aggregate density, and interfacial structure, as assessed by radius of gyration distributions, radial density profiles, and hyperbolic-tangent fits to the droplet interface. Racemic systems exhibit higher backbone contact counts and greater peptide compaction than their homochiral counterparts, consistent with the formation of dense, disordered aggregates characteristic of the liquid coacervate phase, where chains maintain close contact without adopting long-range β-sheet order. These results provide molecular-level support for the macroscopic observation that racemic patterning favors coacervate over precipitate formation, and reveal that alternating chirality promotes compact, entangled chain conformations that satisfy backbone hydrogen bonding outside of canonical β-sheet structures rather than simply eliminating it, a mechanism beyond β-sheet disruption alone. Hydrophobicity-dependent trends in secondary structure and solvent exposure are well reproduced regardless of chiral patterning, establishing SIRAH as a viable framework for peptide-based coacervate simulations and identifying stereochemical patterning as an independent sequence-specific route for tuning coacervate density. Because the SIRAH protein and nucleic acid parameters were derived within a single, structurally consistent framework, the same approach extends naturally to peptide–nucleic acid complex coacervates, an assembly class of growing interest for delivery applications and one that few coarse-grained force fields can treat at backbone-level resolution.
items.authors: Tania Rajpersaud, Tahoora Ateeq, Lorraine Leon, Sergio Pantano, Sharon Loverde
items.title_zh: 手性图案驱动肽共沉淀形成的粗粒度SIRAH模拟研究
items.summary_zh: 肽基聚电解质复合物（PECs）是一类有前景的刺激响应材料，广泛应用于药物传递。然而，手性图案如何影响其相行为的分子机制尚未解决。研究表明，外消旋手性图案通过破坏有序的β-折叠结构，促进液态共沉淀的形成。粗粒度分子动力学模拟为研究共沉淀相行为提供了有效途径，但需要捕捉序列依赖的结构倾向的力场。本文扩展了SIRAH粗粒度力场，以模拟手性和疏水性图案化的肽基PEC系统。通过引入D-手性二面角参数，模拟了六种模型PEC系统的外消旋和同手性变体，并将结果与微秒级原子模拟和已发布的FTIR二级结构数据进行了比较。外消旋SIRAH模型再现了肽的紧凑性、聚集密度和界面结构的原子趋势。

items.title: StateFlux: Physically Validated Quantum Metabolic State Networks Reveal Limited Incremental Value for Toxicity Prediction
items.abstract: Mechanistic molecular representations are increasingly proposed as a route to improve toxicity prediction by supplementing parent structure with protonation, metabolism, and quantum-chemical reactivity. Whether those physically richer representations provide predictive information that is genuinely orthogonal to molecular structure remains uncertain. Here, StateFlux represents each drug as a network of chemical and predicted metabolic states with node-level GFN2-xTB properties and edge-resolved changes in ionization potential, electron affinity, electrophilicity, solvation, and local reactivity. On a locked DILIrank 2.0 development set (n = 376; 156 DILI-positive and 220 DILI-negative compounds), 10 × 5 scaffold validation gave AUROC/AUPRC values of 0.8249/0.7727 for ECFP, 0.8049/0.7430 for ECFP + FluxCore, and 0.8010/0.7261 for ECFP + StateFluxCore. The FluxCore AUROC decrement relative to ECFP was -0.0199 (95% paired-bootstrap CI, -0.0341 to -0.0072). Strict temporal and scaffold-novel tests likewise showed no consistent advantage, and an independent 5,367-compound genotoxicity benchmark reproduced the result (AUROC 0.7765 for ECFP versus 0.7732 for StateFluxCore). To distinguish limited predictive utility from inaccurate low-cost quantum chemistry, 24 parent-to-metabolite transformations were re-evaluated with 144 ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD single-point calculations. GFN2-xTB closely tracked DFT changes in electrophilicity (Pearson r = 0.963; MAE = 0.408 eV; 79.2% sign agreement). Thus, transformation-induced quantum reactivity can be physically meaningful without providing reliable incremental information for broad toxicity classification. These results argue that mechanistic fidelity and predictive utility should be validated separately when increasingly elaborate molecular representations are introduced into chemical machine learning.
items.authors: Aris Tsai
items.title_zh: StateFlux：物理验证的量子代谢状态网络对毒性预测的增值有限
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了机制性分子表征在毒性预测中的应用，结合了质子化、代谢和量子化学反应性。StateFlux将每种药物表示为化学和预测代谢状态的网络，节点具有GFN2-xTB特性，边缘则反映了电离势、电子亲和力、电亲和性、溶剂化和局部反应性的变化。在锁定的DILIrank 2.0开发集中（n = 376；156个DILI阳性和220个DILI阴性化合物），10 × 5支架验证显示，ECFP的AUROC/AUPRC值为0.8249/0.7727，ECFP + FluxCore为0.8049/0.7430，ECFP + StateFluxCore为0.8010/0.7261。FluxCore相对于ECFP的AUROC降幅为-0.0199，严格的时间和支架新颖性测试同样未显示出一致的优势。独立的5,367个化合物基因毒性基准测试重现了这一结果（ECFP AUROC为0.7765，StateFluxCore为0.7732）。为区分有限的预测效用与不准确的低成本量子化学，重新评估了24个母体到代谢物的转化，进行了144个ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD单点计算。

items.title: A Convenient Crystalline Acyl Silane for the Colorimetric Titration of Diisobutylaluminum Hydride (DIBAL)
items.abstract: Due to the intense color associated with acyl silanes and their fast reaction with DIBAL to generate colorless alcohols, these properties were utilized to develop a colorimetric titration of DIBAL. A convenient crystalline acyl silane was identified that can be prepared on gram scale without the need for chromatographic purification by direct crystallization of the reaction products. Use of this material for the colorimetric titration of DIBAL and n-BuLi was possible. A variety of other 2 hydride and organometallic reagents were also tested and showed unsatisfactory endpoints. This work was performed by an American Chemical Society Project SEED student during their summer fellowship under the direction of a senior graduate student. The work disclosed could be suitable for application to an advanced undergraduate level laboratory related to the titration of reactive hydride reagents including the significance of atom effects on the physical and chemical properties or organic compounds.
items.authors: Stephen Collins, Colby Basnett, Joshua D. Sieber
items.title_zh: 一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷用于二异丁基铝氢化物的比色滴定
items.summary_zh: 由于酰基硅烷的强烈颜色及其与二异丁基铝氢化物（DIBAL）迅速反应生成无色醇的特性，研究开发了一种DIBAL的比色滴定方法。研究中识别出一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷，可在克级规模上制备，无需通过色谱纯化，直接结晶反应产物。该材料可用于DIBAL和n-BuLi的比色滴定。还测试了多种其他氢化物和有机金属试剂，但结果不理想。该研究由美国化学学会Project SEED的学生在一名高级研究生的指导下进行，适合应用于与反应性氢化物试剂滴定相关的高级本科实验室。

items.title: Closing the Loop Between Synthetic and Living Cells
items.abstract: Synthetic cells are moving beyond compartmentalised microreactors to become integrated components of biological networks that physically and chemically merge with their hosts. Existing reviews classify this field by mode of emission, by chemistry, or by architecture, and so describe the construct rather than its effect. This review takes the receiver's side, treating the functional adaptation of the living host as the readout of bio-hybrid function: how living cells probe their synthetic partners mechanically and adapt to them metabolically. We consider the bio-hybrid interface by how far the feedback loop (sensing-actuation) is closed and set out the evidence that would place a study in each of four tiers: open-loop, half-loop, partial feedback, and closed-loop. Read against these criteria, fifteen of the eighteen studies surveyed here are half-loop, three reach partial feedback, and none is closed-loop. All three partial-feedback systems work the same way, by metabolic interception, which the existing taxonomies have no category for. The one construct that comes closest to closed-loop operation contains no living cell at all. We then trace how single-cell coupling is scaling into hybrid prototissues that act as discovery platforms for pathological microenvironments, and we outline the translational barriers these constructs must survive to reach the clinic.
items.authors: Ion Ioannou

items.title: A Physically Grounded Discrete Causal Recording Formalism Based on Spatiotemporal Isolation for Surface Propagation Pattern Reconstruction
items.abstract: This study introduces a pattern-oriented mathematical framework, termed the causal recording framework, which is conceptually rooted in cellular automata and consists of a discrete state layer that encodes physical information.Unlike Laplacian-based continuous partial differential equations (PDEs), which are successfully established for domain-dependent macroscopic pattern generation, the causal recording framework generates and records each local state solely from previously registered causal states, regardless of domain size, while incorporating time irreversibility and dissipative structures.The framework is applied to deterministic geometric order on liquid surfaces and validated through direct experiments and pattern reconstruction.Numerical pattern reconstructions demonstrate that the framework can reconstruct the evolution of real water ripple patterns.This research also reports that disordered, symmetry-breaking ripples on water surfaces can evolve into highly organized symmetric water patterns.This transition is reconstructed through a single causal recording framework, suggesting that emergent regularity arises from the interaction of identical local rules without any modification of the governing equations.The results also suggest that spatial confinement and local source information are critical factors in transforming disordered asymmetric patterns into highly ordered Faraday-wave-like patterns.These findings demonstrate the validity of the causal recording formulation as an effective framework for describing natural pattern formation characterized by domain independence, dissipative structures, and time irreversibility.
items.authors: Junhyung Lee

items.title: Quantification of Levoglucosan in Biomass Burning Particulate Matter Using a Glucometer Test Strip
items.abstract: Levoglucosan (LG) is highly abundant in biomass pyrolysate and is widely used as a tracer for biomass burning in environmental sciences. Current analytical standards rely on gas or liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry (GC/LC-MS). Because these methods are expensive, there is a critical need for low-cost alternatives. This work explores using commercial glucometer strips to detect and quantify LG by first converting it into d-glucose with heat and acid. The hydrolysis condition was optimized to be at 150 °C, with 0.1 M H2SO4, for 60 min, while the sample was buffered at pH 7.3 for optimal detection. Following the optimization of the hydrolysis protocol, the glucometer strip signal exhibited a linear response, which was statistically indistinguishable from the response to d-glucose. However, when applied to authentic biomass burning filter samples, the glucometer method yielded concentrations approximately twice as high as GC–MS measurements. This discrepancy is likely due to interfering compounds in the sample matrix that also release d-glucose upon hydrolysis. Overall, this study establishes the proof-of-concept for using off-the-shelf glucometer testing strips for LG detection, while highlighting the distinct challenges of applying this method to complex environmental samples.
items.authors: Amanda Hanashiro Moraes, Antonio Mirante, Dylan Long, Faisal Hossain, Michael Serpe, Ran Zhao

items.title: Computer Vision for Predicting Electrochemical Reaction Performance from Electroanalytical Data
items.abstract: Electrosynthesis has surfaced as a key approach in modern synthesis, enabling more sustainable chemical transformations with reduced chemical waste. The accurate prediction of electrosynthesis performance is crucial for accelerating the discovery and design of reactions. Despite indisputable advances, the descriptor-based predictions fall short in representing the full reaction regime due to the high‑dimensional parameter space of electrosynthesis. Cyclic voltammograms, which are typically employed for mechanistic analysis, inherently contain rich information about electrochemical processes. Herein, we applied computer vision techniques to collect a cyclic voltammogram image database and trained a neural network directly on these image data. The resulting models achieved reliable performance in predicting electrosynthesis outcomes, demonstrating the potential of image-based deep learning for electrochemical reaction evaluation and data-driven electrosynthesis studies.
items.authors: Xinran Chen, Sven Erik Peters, Lutz Ackermann
items.title_zh: 基于计算机视觉预测电化学反应性能的研究
items.summary_zh: 电合成作为现代合成中的关键方法，能够实现更可持续的化学转化，减少化学废物。准确预测电合成性能对于加速反应的发现和设计至关重要。尽管已有显著进展，但基于描述符的预测在表征电合成的高维参数空间时仍显不足。循环伏安图通常用于机制分析，内含丰富的电化学过程信息。本研究应用计算机视觉技术构建循环伏安图像数据库，并直接在这些图像数据上训练神经网络。所得到的模型在预测电合成结果方面表现可靠，展示了基于图像的深度学习在电化学反应评估和数据驱动电合成研究中的潜力。

items.title: Gas-Phase Fragmentation in Mass Spectrometry Informs the Shape and Topology of Thiolated Metal Nanoclusters
items.abstract: Thiolated metal nanoclusters (NCs), comprising a metal core protected by outer-layer staple motifs, have attracted widespread interest due to their promising applications in catalysis, biosensing, and biomedicine. While mass spectrometry (MS) is widely used to determine the chemical composition of metal NCs via intact mass measurement, its potential for in-depth structural analysis via gas-phase fragmentation in tandem MS (MS/MS) has been relatively underexplored and mostly focused on the collision induced dissociation (CID) technique involving gas collisions. Herein, we systematically compared the fragmentation pathways between CID and an alternative method, surface induced dissociation (SID), using model Au NCs featuring distinct symmetries and structural motifs. We show that gas-phase fragments in CID and SID overall shared the common fragmentation behavior of breaking the outer staples of Au NCs, but with different preferences in the location of bond cleavages. In addition, SID showed characteristic Au losses in ellipsoidal Au NCs with trimeric staples; and fragmentation efficiency in CID and SID varied differentially according to the shape of the NCs. Building on these findings, we applied the method to study non-crystallizable Au-Ag NCs with heterogeneous stoichiometry. The SID fragmentation data helped locate the Au and Ag atoms, providing valuable insights into the synthetic pathway of the NCs, which was otherwise inaccessible experimentally. Together, these results support SID as a complementary MS/MS tool for metal NCs, with particular promise for heterogeneous systems like the mixed NCs that cannot be easily crystallized.
items.authors: Long Shi, Luoming Zhang, Zebo Li, Zijie Chen, Yuqing Yao, Ruikang Tang
items.title_zh: 气相碎裂质谱法揭示硫醇化金属纳米簇的形状与拓扑
items.summary_zh: 硫醇化金属纳米簇（NCs）由金属核心和外层保护结构组成，因其在催化、生物传感和生物医学中的潜在应用而受到广泛关注。虽然质谱（MS）常用于通过完整质量测量确定金属NCs的化学成分，但其在气相碎裂中的结构分析潜力尚未得到充分探索。本文系统比较了碰撞诱导解离（CID）和表面诱导解离（SID）两种方法的碎裂路径，使用具有不同对称性和结构特征的金纳米簇作为模型。结果表明，CID和SID中的气相碎片在破坏金纳米簇外层结构方面表现出相似的碎裂行为，但在键断裂位置上存在不同偏好。此外，SID在具有三聚体结构的椭球形金纳米簇中显示出特征性的金损失；CID和SID的碎裂效率则根据纳米簇的形状有所不同。基于这些发现，我们进一步研究了具有异质化学计量的非结晶金银纳米簇，SID碎裂数据帮助定位了金和银原子，为合成提供了重要见解。

items.title: Framework Connectivity Tunes the Nuclear Spin Bath and Extends Coherence in Cu(II) Metal–Organic Framework Qubit Lattices
items.abstract: Designing solid-state spin-qubit arrays that retain long coherence at high spin density remains a central challenge in quantum information materials. In molecular qubits, this challenge arises because the same local coordination environment and lattice architecture that define the spin array also control the dominant decoherence channels, most notably nuclear-spin spectral diffusion and coupling to low-frequency phonons. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are therefore especially attractive because they combine dense, crystalline spin arrays with chemically programmable control over the coordination environment, framework connectivity, and supramolecular packing, yet a fundamental understanding of how specific structural changes translate into predictable relaxation behavior remains underdeveloped. Here we compare two closely related oxygen-coordinated Cu(II) frameworks, Cu-TPTC and Cu-TPTriC, that preserve the same first-sphere donor set while changing connectivity and supramolecular packing. Cu-TPTC comprises one-dimensional Cu–O chains assembled into hydrogen-bonded rods, whereas Cu-TPTriC forms coordination-connected Cu–O–Cu two-dimensional sheets that stack through interlayer aromatic contacts in the absence of hydrogen-bond stitching. Continuous-wave electron paramagnetic resonance (CW-EPR) spectroscopy shows that both lattices exhibit relatively narrow linewidths compared with a Cu–N porphyrinic benchmark, consistent with reduced ligand-derived superhyperfine broadening in an oxygenonly coordination sphere. Pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance measurements establish coherent spin control and reveal systematically longer spin–lattice relaxation times (T1) and phase-memory times (Tm) in Cu-TPTriC over 5–25 K, with Tm≈4.8 ± 0.011 μs at 5 K. This coherence gain persists despite substantially shorter Cu···Cu separations in Cu-TPTriC and is consistent with a reduced proton-bath density and modified lattice dynamics, as reflected in the weaker electron spin echo envelope modulation (ESEEM) observed for Cu-TPTriC. Together, these results suggest that within dense oxygen-coordinated Cu(II) framework lattices, the secondary-sphere nuclear-spin environment and lattice dynamics can play an important role in governing decoherence, potentially outweighing spin spacing alone.
items.authors: Kavish Saini, Sisheed Sivaraman, Prashanna Poudel, Bonaventure A. Odeke, Gajadhar Joshi, Manny de Jesus Lopez
items.title_zh: 框架连通性调节核自旋浴并延长Cu(II)金属有机框架量子比特的相干性
items.summary_zh: 设计能够在高自旋密度下保持长相干性的固态自旋量子比特阵列是量子信息材料中的一大挑战。在分子量子比特中，这一挑战源于局部配位环境和晶格结构不仅定义了自旋阵列，还控制了主要的去相干通道，特别是核自旋谱扩散和与低频声子的耦合。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其结合了致密的晶体自旋阵列和可化学编程的配位环境、框架连通性及超分子堆积而显得尤为吸引。本文比较了两个密切相关的氧配位Cu(II)框架Cu-TPTC和Cu-TPTriC，前者由一维Cu-O链组成，后者形成二维Cu-O-Cu片层。连续波电子顺磁共振（CW-EPR）光谱显示，两种晶格的线宽相对较窄。

items.title: Differentiable mass transfer modeling enables wet lab validated inverse analysis of liquid chromatography
items.abstract: Liquid chromatography (LC) is essential to organic synthesis and emerging selfdriving laboratories (SDLs), yet LC method development remains cost-intensive and dependent on expert intuition. Mechanistic chromatographic models offer a route to transferable and data-efficient method development, but their practical use is limited by the computational cost of inverse modeling and by the ill-posedness of parameter estimation from experimental chromatograms. Here we report a wet-lab-validated differentiable physics framework for LC inverse modeling. The framework integrates mechanistic column modeling with physics-informed machine learning (PIML) to enable efficient forward simulation and gradient-based inverse estimation of molecular transport and adsorption parameters from gradient-elution chromatograms. The primary PINN surrogate reproduces the mechanistic reference with a root-mean-square error of 10−3 in dimensionless concentration. To address the ill-posed nature of the inverse problem, we introduce an observability-guided experimental-design strategy that quantifies parameter identifiability and incorporates this information into the inverse objective to promote convergence toward the ground-truth parameters. Across 300 dry-lab simulation parameter combinations, the proposed strategy recovered the ground-truth parameters with relative errors ≤ 10% in 88.3% of cases using three gradient programs, compared with only 6.7% using a single gradient program. We further validate the framework against wet-lab LC 1 measurements, achieving an absolute retention-time error ≤ 10 s for 89.3% of samples and establishing a wet-lab database comprising 731 sets of transport and adsorption parameters extracted from 2,553 gradient-elution LC chromatograms. This work provides an observability-aware differentiable modeling foundation for autonomous LC method development and closed-loop analytical decision-making in AI-driven laboratories.
items.authors: Baochen Li, Zihan Zhou, Yanqing Yu, Sen Lin, Peng Wang, Tianshu Yu
items.title_zh: 可微分质量传递建模实现液相色谱逆向分析
items.summary_zh: 液相色谱（LC）在有机合成和新兴自驱动实验室（SDL）中至关重要，但其方法开发仍然成本高昂且依赖专家直觉。机制性色谱模型为可转移和数据高效的方法开发提供了途径，但其实际应用受到逆向建模计算成本和实验色谱图参数估计不适定性的限制。本文报告了一种经过湿实验验证的可微分物理框架用于LC逆向建模。该框架将机制性柱模型与物理信息机器学习（PIML）相结合，实现了从梯度洗脱色谱图中高效的正向模拟和基于梯度的逆向估计。主要的PINN代理在无量纲浓度上重现机制性参考，均方根误差为10−3。为解决逆问题的不适定性，我们引入了一种可观测性引导的实验设计策略，量化参数可识别性，并将该信息纳入逆向目标，以促进向真实参数的收敛。在300个干实验模拟参数组合中，该策略在88.3%的情况下以相对误差≤10%恢复了真实参数。

items.title: An analytical potential energy surface and variational transition-state theory kinetics of the NH3 + Br → NH2 + HBr hydrogen-abstraction reaction
items.abstract: We report the first full-dimensional analytical potential energy surface (PES) and a variational transitionstate theory (VTST) study of the endothermic gas-phase reaction NH3 + Br −−→ NH2 + HBr, completing the halogen series (NH3 + F, Cl, Br) of the group’s analytical surfaces. Stationary points and energetics were benchmarked at the CCSD(T)/CBS level with the bromine 3d shell frozen; a −3.51 kcal/mol spinorbit correction was added to the NH3 + Br asymptote for the Br(2P) splitting. The benchmark locates a genuine, product-like (Hammond) saddle 17.6 kcal/mol above reactants but submerged 2.1 kcal/mol below the NH2+HBr asymptote (zero-point-and spin–orbit-corrected). A valence-bond/molecular-mechanics PES was calibrated to reproduce these stationary points to better than 0.25 kcal/mol; it retains an exact analytical gradient and dedicated van der Waals wells for the entrance (NH3···Br) and exit (NH2···HBr) complexes. Canonical variational theory with multidimensional tunneling (µOMT) yields forward rate constants over 200 K to 2000 K. Because the adiabatic barrier lies below the product asymptote, the tunneling coefficient is unity and the reverse reaction NH2 +HBr −−→ NH3 +Br exhibits a negative apparent activation energy, as measured for the carbon analogue CH3 +HBr. Quasi-classical trajectories on the same surface, once product zero-point leakage is accounted for, reproduce the variational forward rate as an independent check of the barrier. In the absence of experimental data, the forward rate constants are presented as predictions anchored to the high-level energetics.
items.authors: Cipriano Rangel
items.title_zh: NH3 + Br反应的分析势能面与变分过渡态理论动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 本文首次报告了NH3 + Br → NH2 + HBr反应的全维分析势能面（PES）及变分过渡态理论（VTST）研究，该反应为吸热气相反应，完成了卤素系列的分析表面。通过CCSD(T)/CBS水平基准计算，固定溴的3d壳层，得到反应物的真实产物样鞍点位于反应物上方17.6 kcal/mol，但低于NH2 + HBr的渐近态2.1 kcal/mol。校准的价键/分子力学PES能够以优于0.25 kcal/mol的精度重现这些静止点，并保留精确的解析梯度及专用的范德瓦尔斯井。采用多维隧穿的经典变分理论（µOMT）计算得出200 K至2000 K的正向速率常数。由于绝热势垒低于产物渐近态，隧穿系数为1，反应NH2 + HBr → NH3 + Br表现出负的表观活化能。

items.title: Assessing the state of the art in ADMET prediction: Lessons from the OpenADMET-ExpansionRx community blind challenge
items.abstract: Computational blind challenges are essential for advancing drug discovery, especially in research areas with limited public data, such as absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity (ADMET) prediction. In this paper, we present the results of our latest community blind challenge, organized in collaboration with Expansion Therapeutics (ExpansionRx). Participants were tasked with predicting nine distinct ADMET endpoints routinely evaluated during lead optimization of compounds in drug discovery programs. Following unprecedented engagement from the global community, this challenge provided valuable insights into the state of the art in machine learning for ADMET modeling. Evaluating submissions against a realistic, challenging dataset from active ExpansionRx drug discovery programs revealed that message-passing neural networks and chemical foundation models dominated among the top performers. Furthermore, the results highlighted the power of proprietary industry datasets and a critical need to optimize predictive workflows for different endpoints independently via multitasking and task-affinity grouping. We also demonstrate how hosting our open-source blind challenge infrastructure on a flexible platform like Hugging Face was pivotal for driving community engagement and visibility. Ultimately, blind challenges supported by robust infrastructure, widespread dissemination, and rigorous post-challenge analysis are fundamental to maximizing the utility of public data releases. We anticipate that these community benchmarks will continue to drive the advancement of ADMET models, enabling their deployment in both early- and late-stage drug discovery.
items.authors: Maria A. Castellanos, Hugo MacDermott-Opeskin, Jon Ainsley, Jonathan A. Swain, Sean Colby, Devany West
items.title_zh: 评估ADMET预测的最新进展：来自OpenADMET-ExpansionRx社区盲挑战的启示
items.summary_zh: 计算盲挑战对于推动药物发现至关重要，尤其是在公共数据有限的领域，如吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）预测。本文展示了与Expansion Therapeutics（ExpansionRx）合作组织的最新社区盲挑战结果。参与者需预测在药物发现程序中常规评估的九个不同ADMET终点。全球社区的积极参与为ADMET建模的机器学习现状提供了宝贵见解。评估提交结果时，基于活跃ExpansionRx药物发现项目的真实挑战数据集显示，消息传递神经网络和化学基础模型在表现最佳的参与者中占主导地位。此外，结果强调了专有行业数据集的优势，以及通过多任务和任务亲和分组独立优化不同终点预测工作流程的必要性。我们还展示了在Hugging Face等灵活平台上托管开源盲挑战基础设施对推动社区参与和可见性的重要性。

items.title: Docking, Molecular Dynamics, QSAR, and Machine Learning in Alzheimer's Small-Molecule Drug Discovery: Current Utility, Key Limitations, and Reproducibility Challenges
items.abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) remains one of the most challenging therapeutic areas for small-molecule drug discovery because of its multifactorial pathology, complex target biology, and demanding central nervous system drug-development requirements. In this context, computational methods have become increasingly important for compound prioritization, hypothesis generation, and structure–activity interpretation. Among these, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, quantitative structure–activity relationship (QSAR) modeling, and machine learning (ML) are widely used in AD-oriented medicinal chemistry, particularly in studies involving targets such as β-secretase 1 (BACE1) and tau. This review critically examines the practical roles of these four approaches in AD small-molecule discovery. Rather than presenting them as universally predictive solutions, the review evaluates their principal strengths, major limitations, and current challenges related to validation, interpretability, reproducibility, and experimental translation. Molecular docking remains useful for structure-based hypothesis generation and binding-pose analysis, especially for structurally characterized targets, but is frequently overinterpreted when numerical scores are treated as direct evidence of biological activity. MD simulations provide a complementary framework for examining protein–ligand stability, conformational flexibility, and interaction persistence, although simulation outcomes remain highly dependent on methodological choices and should not be regarded as definitive validation of binding or efficacy. QSAR continues to support ligand-based activity modeling and analogue prioritization, but its utility depends strongly on dataset quality, applicability domain, and validation strategy. ML offers greater flexibility for activity and property prediction, including multi-parameter prioritization and ADMET-related modeling, yet remains sensitive to dataset bias, overfitting, limited interpretability, and poor reproducibility. Across all four approaches, the review emphasizes that methodological rigor is at least as important as methodological sophistication. Particular attention is given to common problems including inadequate validation, overinterpretation of computational outputs, limited reproducibility, and weak integration with experimental medicinal chemistry. Overall, molecular docking, MD simulations, QSAR, and ML are best viewed as complementary support tools whose value depends on careful application, transparent reporting, and close integration with experimental evidence. A more critical, reproducible, and biologically informed use of these methods is likely to provide a stronger foundation for future AD small-molecule discovery. Keywords
items.authors: Poulami Saha, Anuja Chouhan
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病小分子药物发现中的计算方法综述
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）因其多因素病理、复杂靶点生物学及中枢神经系统药物开发要求，成为小分子药物发现中最具挑战性的领域之一。计算方法在化合物优先级排序、假设生成和结构-活性解释中日益重要。分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟、定量结构-活性关系（QSAR）建模和机器学习（ML）在AD药物化学中被广泛应用，尤其是在β-分泌酶1（BACE1）和tau等靶点研究中。本文批判性地审视了这四种方法在AD小分子发现中的实际作用，评估了它们的主要优势、局限性及与验证、可解释性、可重复性和实验转化相关的挑战。分子对接在基于结构的假设生成和结合位点分析中仍然有用，但当数值评分被视为生物活性的直接证据时，常常被过度解读。MD模拟为研究蛋白-配体稳定性提供了补充框架。

items.title: Accelerating Lead Optimization away from Anti-Targets: Navigating the Structural Complexity of Promiscuous ADMET Proteins
items.abstract: The development of a small-molecule suitable for clinical use involves optimization of ligand binding to an identified target protein but also frequently the reduction of binding to a variety of anti-target proteins known to pose translational risk. These anti-targets, often referred to as ADMET proteins, often contain large, highly flexible binding sites leading to promiscuous binding of small molecules. This property often frustrates efforts to execute structure-based design against these anti-targets. Here we demonstrate the application of a combination of induced fit docking and free energy perturbation to structurally enable several of the most common anti-targets: cytochrome P450 isoforms 3A4 and 2D6, the hERG ion channel, and PXR. Crucially, the enforcement of a consensus binding mode across a congeneric series allowed for the efficient exploration of a wide range of receptor conformation space. Results are presented for both public retrospective datasets and prospective application in active drug discovery programs.
items.authors: Howook Hwang, Mee Shelley, Andrew Placzek, Kevin Demarco, Steven Albanese, Andreas Verras
items.title_zh: 加速优化小分子药物以避开抗靶点
items.summary_zh: 小分子药物的开发需要优化与目标蛋白的配体结合，同时减少与多种已知具有转化风险的抗靶点蛋白的结合。这些抗靶点通常被称为ADMET蛋白，具有大且高度灵活的结合位点，导致小分子的多重结合特性，给基于结构的设计带来挑战。本文展示了诱导适配对接和自由能扰动相结合的方法，成功地对常见抗靶点（如细胞色素P450同种型3A4和2D6、hERG离子通道及PXR）进行结构优化。通过在同系系列中强制一致的结合模式，有效探索了广泛的受体构象空间。结果展示了公共回顾性数据集和在活跃药物发现项目中的前瞻性应用。

items.title: Candidate Vacuolar Lipases and Vacuolar Processing Enzymes Associated with Late Autophagic Degradation in Carbon-Starved Lupin ( em Lupinus /em spp.) Embryonic Axes
items.abstract: The degradation of autophagic bodies in the plant vacuole is required to complete autophagic flux, yet the hydrolases involved in membrane breakdown and cargo processing remain incompletely defined. We investigated candidate vacuolar lipases and vacuolar processing enzymes (VPEs) in embryonic axes of white lupin (Lupinus albus L.) and Andean lupin (Lupinus mutabilis Sweet) exposed to carbon starvation. Carbon starvation increased total p-nitrophenyl-palmitate-hydrolyzing and Ac-ESEN-MCA-hydrolyzing activities, whereas asparagine and pharmacological perturbation of autophagic or vacuolar processes attenuated these responses. AlphaFold 3 models, enhanced conformational sampling, and molecular docking indicated that selected candidate lipases possess α/β-hydrolase-like architectures and can accommodate several membrane-associated lipids; however, these predictions do not establish catalytic activity or physiological substrate preference. Vacuole-targeted XP_019420123.1 failed to restore Ape1 maturation or AtAtg8a-GFP processing in Saccharomyces cerevisiae atg15Δ cells, indicating that the construct did not functionally substitute for Atg15 under the conditions tested. By contrast, partial inhibition of VPE-like activity with Ac-YVAD-cmk increased the number of intravacuolar autophagic-body-like structures while phagophores and autophagosomes remained detectable. Transcriptomic and RT-qPCR analyses further revealed gene-specific responses of VPE/legumain transcripts to carbon status and pharmacological treatments. Collectively, the results support an association between VPE-like proteolytic activity and efficient late intravacuolar degradation during carbon starvation. The analyzed lipases remain candidates for vacuolar lipid metabolism, but direct biochemical and genetic evidence is required before assigning them a role in autophagic-body membrane hydrolysis.
items.authors: Karolina Wleklik, Maciej Janicki, Katarzyna Nuc, Małgorzata Pietrowska-Borek, Amélie Bernard, Inés Toboso Moreno

items.title: Algorithmic Democracy and Constitutional Firewalls: The Governance Architecture of Negentropic Value Currency
items.abstract: The first paper of the negentropic value currency program established the value ontology and the microeconomic incentives (Cheng and Cheng 2026a); the second proved that macrostability is equivalent to the maintenance of four integrity conditions — the measurement layer unfalsified, the calibration layer uncaptured, the issuance layer uncorrupted, and the extinction layer unfailing (Cheng and Cheng 2026b). Both papers, however, left the guardian of integrity offstage: they assumed the existence of legitimate accounting, consensus, and supervision procedures without specifying the procedures themselves. The present paper takes up this suspended constitutional question: who guards the four integrity conditions, and by whom, through what procedures, and under what constraints is α set, so that the system escapes majoritarian tyranny, technocratic rule, and the alienation of algorithmic black boxes alike? We formalize the problem as the delegation of value judgments and propose a three-tier governance architecture. The first tier is the bicameral algorithmic democracy of the Global Value Parliament (GVP): a House of Citizens generated by three-dimensional stratified sortition (500 seats, three-year terms, no reappointment) and a House of Experts nominated by authoritative learned bodies and confirmed through peer review (300 seats, six-year terms), with revisions of core parameters requiring a double majority in both houses. The second tier is three constitutional firewalls — the Minority Protection and Exploration Fund (value-inclusion axis), the independent Algorithmic Ethics and Audit Committee (process-oversight axis, with quarterly disparate-impact audits and emergency braking powers, extended here to the audit of the extinction layer), and a blockchain-notarized platform of popular oversight (popular-oversight axis, with million-signature initiatives and a 70% opposition re-review rule). The third tier is an economic constitution of metabolic governance, now with four clauses: the intrinsic metabolism rate δ, the Civilization Time Bank, financial minimalism, and knowledge-genealogy attribution with intergenerational decay of inheritance. A guardianship matrix assigns every institution to the integrity condition it defends, and the capture-cost proposition states that global capture is conjunctively superadditive. The teleological loop then anchors the architecture to the survival and elevation of civilization: knowing, utilizing, and mastering cosmic truth, until the withdrawal of money itself. Every mechanism is accompanied by its failure-mode analysis, and all claims of validity are marked as designed but unexecuted.
items.authors: Dian Cheng, Jinjun Cheng

items.title: Optimal Scalarization Functions for Neutrosophic Quantum Search
items.abstract: Quantum search algorithms provide a quadratic speedup for a broad class of unstructured search problems. In practical settings, however, the classification of a candidate as “good” or “bad” may itself contain uncertainty, indeterminacy, or contradictory information. Neutrosophic sets provide a natural mathematical language for representing such information through independent truth, indeterminacy, and falsity degrees. In this paper we introduce a scalarization framework for neutrosophic quantum search. The central idea is to transform a neutrosophic evaluation N = (T, I, F) into a real-valued utility while preserving the distinction between truth, indeterminacy, and falsity. We introduce a parameterized family of weighted scalarization functions and establish conditions under which these functions are normalized, monotone, continuous, and order-preserving. We then define an optimization criterion for choosing scalarization parameters according to the requirements of a quantum search problem. A neutrosophic quantum oracle is modeled by assigning a neutrosophic evaluation to each computational basis state. The resulting scalarized oracle determines the effective marked-state amplitude. We derive an explicit relationship between scalarized utility and the number of amplitude-amplification iterations. Several scalarization functions, including linear, nonlinear, entropy-sensitive, and indeterminacy-penalized forms, are compared. A theoretical criterion based on discrimination, robustness, and indeterminacy sensitivity is proposed. The resulting framework provides a mathematically explicit bridge between neutrosophic decision theory and quantum amplitude amplification.
items.authors: Saeid Jafari

items.title: Prognostic Determinants and Scoring Systems in Fournier Gangrene: A Narrative Review
items.abstract: Background: Fournier’s gangrene (FG) is a rapidly progressive necrotizing soft-tissue infection associated with substantial mortality despite modern surgical, antimicrobial, and critical-care management. Objective: To synthesize the evidence supporting clinical determinants, FG-specific severity scores, LRINEC, inflammatory biomarkers, general critical-care and comorbidity instruments, and emerging mortality indices in FG. Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched for publications from 1980 to 2026 using terms related to FG, necrotizing fasciitis, mortality prediction, FGSI, UFGSI, SFGSI, LRINEC, NLR, SOFA/qSOFA, NEWS2, APACHE, Charlson indices, Surgical Apgar Score, FGMI, and FGMI-2P. Original derivation studies, validation cohorts, comparative studies, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses were prioritized. Diagnostic instruments were considered separately from mortality-prediction tools, and retained quantitative claims were checked against their cited primary sources. Results: Large syntheses place FG mortality at approximately 16–20%, with one 25-year review reporting 19.8% mortality among 6,152 cases and no significant temporal improvement [8]. FGSI, UFGSI, and SFGSI remain the best-established FG-specific composite scores; a 40-study meta-analysis reported pooled AUCs of 0.90, 0.94, and 0.84, respectively [21]. LRINEC was developed for diagnosis of necrotizing fasciitis and performs less consistently for mortality prediction in FG [19,20,25,27]. NLR is associated with mortality at thresholds of ≥8 and ≥10 but is best regarded as an adjunct rather than a stand-alone score [73]. CCI/ACCI, SOFA/qSOFA, NEWS2, and APACHE II add information on comorbidity and systemic severity, whereas FGMI and FGMI-2P are promising newer indices requiring further external validation [20,27,28,49,54,60]. Conclusions: Prognostic assessment in FG is best approached as multidimensional. FG-specific scores should be interpreted together with organ dysfunction, comorbidity burden, and inflammatory/nutritional markers. No prognostic score should delay resuscitation, broad-spectrum antimicrobial therapy, or urgent surgical source control.
items.authors: Pantelie Nicolcescu, Aurel Nechita, Manuela Arbune, Mădălina-Nicoleta Matei, Gabriel Valeriu Popa, Maria Filofteia Mercuț

items.title: Children’s Experiences of Neighborhood Food Environments, Eating Practices, and Subjective Well-Being: A Participatory Qualitative Study in Chile
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Food environments shape children’s eating practices yet lived experiences remain insufficiently understood. This study explored how children and adolescents experience neighborhood food environments in relation to dimensions of subjective well-being in a context of social vulnerability in Chile. Methods: A quali-tative participatory study was conducted with 15 children and adolescents aged 12–15 years in La Legua and Carmen Mena, San Joaquín. Data were generated through Pho-tovoice, interviews, and emotional mapping. Photographs, maps, transcripts, and field notes were integrated and analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis, complemented by spatial analysis of emotional maps. Results: Five themes were identified: proximity, mobility, and safety; availability, diversity, and food procurement; food as an affective, familial, and social experience; children’s agency; and tensions among practices, pref-erences, restrictions, and aspirations. Nearby food outlets facilitated access, whereas insecurity constrained mobility. Multiple points of sale did not necessarily translate into food diversity, with circuits centered on bread, beverages, snacks, sweets, and fast food. Food experiences included pleasure, care, recognition, togetherness, security, and relief, alongside concern and distress. Children selected, purchased, prepared, and evaluated food within family, economic, and territorial constraints. Conclusions: Neighborhood food environments were experienced as territorial, social, and affective spaces. Access depended not only on availability and proximity but also on safety, prices, mobility, family relationships, preferences, and situated agency. Participatory approaches can broaden nutrition research by revealing how children experience and negotiate food environments.
items.authors: Cristóbal Dauvin, Denise Oyarzún

items.title: A Comparative Finite Element Analysis of Thread Geometry, Loading Direction, and Implant Material on Stress Distribution and Deformation in Dental Implants
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: This study evaluates the effects of axial and inclined loading on dental implants modeled with different material properties, thread geometries, and micro-thread configurations to compare their relative effects on stress and deformation behavior in cortical and cancellous bone. Methods: Five implant materials—dentine, titanium, ZrO2, PEEK, and CFR-PEEK—were analyzed. Each implant model incorporated one of three primary thread designs: buttress, V-thread, or reverse buttress, with and without micro-threads. A three-dimensional finite element model of the implant embedded in cortical and cancellous bone was developed and subjected to a 111.8 N load, representing typical human bite force, applied both axially and at an inclination using ANSYS Workbench 2023 R1. Results: Inclined loading generated substantially higher cortical stress and higher deformation in both cortical and cancellous bone compared to axial loading. Among the materials tested, PEEK exhibited the highest cortical stress concentration and the highest deformation, whereas CFR-PEEK produced the smallest stiffness mismatch with bone among the implant materials, giving intermediate peri-implant stress and deformation, particularly when combined with reverse buttress threads. The effect of micro-threads on cortical stress was material-dependent, increasing for the lower-modulus materials and decreasing slightly for titanium and zirconia. Conclusions: Within the assumptions of this model, CFR-PEEK with reverse buttress threads produced intermediate stress and deformation values between the stiff (titanium, zirconia) and compliant (PEEK) materials under the modelled conditions. Any localized stress change associated with micro-threads represents a change in the computed stress field only; any implication for bone adaptation or osseointegration is beyond the scope of this stress-based model. These findings represent comparative design tendencies that require experimental and clinical validation.
items.authors: Priyanshu Roy, Shah Mohammed Abdul Khader, Lakshmi Puzhankara, Afiya Eram, Mohammad Zuber, Augustine Benjamin Valerian Barboza

items.title: Deep Learning-Based Monitoring of Tension and Fatigue in a Hybrid Mooring System of a Floating Offshore Wind Turbine
items.abstract: Mooring integrity monitoring of floating offshore wind turbines (FOWTs) is constrained by the cost and limited reliability of subsea tension sensors. This study develops a deep learning framework that predicts the dynamic tension of a hybrid polyester–chain mooring system for a 15 MW semi-submersible FOWT from the platform six-degree-of-freedom motion alone. A database of fully coupled OrcaFlex simulations was generated for sea states off Hsinchu, Taiwan, and split at the simulation level with cluster stratification. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), and Convolutional Neural Network–LSTM (CNN-LSTM) architectures were compared, and the predicted tension was processed by rainflow counting and Miner’s rule to evaluate fatigue damage. On the test set, all three models exceeded an R2 of 0.999, with BiLSTM the most accurate at an RMSE of 11.15 kN, despite the nonlinear axial stiffness of the polyester segment. The predictions were insensitive to the random wave realization, and the accuracy was maintained on sea states and loading directions absent from training. Applied to the recorded conditions of Typhoon KRATHON, in which wind and wave are misaligned by up to 54°, the framework reproduced the one-day cumulative fatigue damage of the simulated tension to within about 4% for LSTM and BiLSTM. With correlated measurement noise on the motion input, the tension error approximately doubles. BiLSTM is recommended for offline monitoring and the unidirectional LSTM for real-time prediction.
items.authors: Yu-Chen Lin, Ray-Yeng Yang

items.title: A New Potentiometric Fluconazole-Selective Sensor Based on a Molecularly Imprinted Polymer
items.abstract: Fluconazole (FLU) is a widely used antifungal drug, and its reliable determination is important for quality control in pharmaceutical analysis. This study aimed to develop a simple and accurate FLU-selective potentiometric sensor based on a molecularly imprinted polymer (MIP). The prepared MIP was evaluated by FT-IR spectroscopy and TG/DSC analysis. The sensor was characterized using direct potentiometry. The influence of membrane composition on sensor response was investigated by varying the MIP content and plasticizer type. The optimized sensor contained 12.5% MIP and dibutyl sebacate as the plasticizer. It exhibited a near-Nernstian response with a slope of 56.1 mV/decade of activity, a wide measuring range (1.0 × 10−7–1.0 × 10−3 M), and a low limit of detection (7.5 × 10−8 M). Additionally, it showed a fast response (5 s), low signal drift (−0.6 mV/h), and excellent selectivity attributed to the recognition properties of the MIP. The sensor applicability was confirmed by FLU determination in standard solutions and pharmaceutical samples using direct potentiometry and the Gran method. Both approaches provided acceptable results, while the Gran method showed slightly better agreement with the expected FLU concentrations, with recoveries within ±10%. The developed sensor enables reliable FLU determination in pharmaceutical samples.

items.title: Synergistic Effects of C-S-H Seeds and PCE on the Performance of Fluoroaluminate-Based Shotcrete: Hydration Kinetics and Microstructural Evolution
items.abstract: To address the trade-off between the rapid setting time and low mechanical strength of fluoroaluminate-based liquid accelerating agents, this study investigated the combined effects of synthetic C-S-H seeds and a polycarboxylate superplasticizer (PCE) on their performance. The underlying mechanisms were explored using isothermal calorimetry, X-ray diffraction (XRD), thermogravimetric analysis (TG), and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The results indicated that the incorporation of C-S-H further accelerated the setting process and significantly improved the 1 d and 3 d compressive strengths of the mortar, with a 1 d strength increase exceeding 30% at a dosage of 1.2%. When combined with PCE, the 1 d strength was further enhanced to 31.5% above the control. Microstructural analysis revealed that C-S-H provided additional nucleation sites for ettringite (AFt), accelerating the early hydration of C3A and increasing the volume of hydration products in the paste. Furthermore, the hydration of the C-S-H seeds themselves contributed to the formation of additional C-S-H gel. This helped alleviate the retarding effect of fluoride ions on C3S hydration, promoted the formation of more hydration products, filled structural pores, and ultimately enhanced the compactness of the paste. The synergistic effect of PCE promoted more complete hydration of C3S, further amplifying the benefits of C-S-H, and leading to a 30.9% increase in C-S-H gel content (reaching 46.1% at 3 days) compared to the control. Consequently, the shotcrete achieved higher mechanical properties and a denser internal structure. The findings demonstrate that a suspension containing 0.9% CSH-PCE significantly improves the performance of a fluoroaluminate-based liquid accelerator by enhancing the early hydration rate and mechanical properties. This provides a theoretical basis for the development of high-performance fluoroaluminate-based liquid accelerators.
items.authors: Yike Lin, Tingshu He, Yongqi Da, Renhe Yang, Xiaodong Ma

items.title: Clonal Relatedness and Transferable Resistance in Carbapenem-Resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae: An Integrated Molecular Epidemiological Study
items.abstract: Background: Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CRKP) represents a major global clinical threat driven by both clonal relatedness and horizontal transfer of antimicrobial resistance determinants. This study aimed to characterize CRKP isolates through an integrated analysis of phenotypic resistance, resistance genes, conjugative transferability, plasmid replicon backgrounds, and clonal relatedness. Methods: A total of 62 confirmed CRKP clinical isolates were investigated. Antimicrobial susceptibility profiles were evaluated according to EUCAST criteria. Carbapenemase, β-lactamase, extended-spectrum β-lactamase-associated, and plasmid-mediated quinolone resistance (PMQR) determinants were screened by PCR. Conjugation experiments were performed using Escherichia coli J53 as the recipient strain. Plasmid replicon typing was conducted on transconjugants by PCR-based replicon typing, and clonal relatedness was assessed by pulsed-field gel electrophoresis (PFGE). Results: All isolates were resistant to ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin, imipenem, ertapenem, meropenem and ampicillin. The most prevalent resistance determinants were oqxA and oqxB (100%), blaSHV (96.8%), blaCTX-M-1 (93.5%), blaTEM and aac(6′)-Ib-cr (85.5% each), qnrD (69.4%), and blaOXA-48 (66.1%). Conjugative transfer was detected in 14 of the 62 isolates (22.6%) under the experimental conditions used. blaOXA-48, blaCTX-M-1, blaTEM, and blaSHV were detected in all transconjugants, whereas aac(6′)-Ib-cr was transferred in only one. IncFIB was the predominant replicon among transconjugants (13/14, 92.9%). PFGE analysis of 57 isolates identified 24 groups and 41 pulsotypes, with one predominant group comprising 29/57 isolates; conjugation-positive isolates were distributed across multiple PFGE backgrounds. Conclusions: The CRKP population showed extensive multidrug resistance together with both clonal clustering and horizontally transferable β-lactam resistance. The unusually high prevalence of sequence-confirmed qnrD represents a distinctive finding and, to the best of our knowledge, the first report of qnrD in clinical Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates from Türkiye. The predominance of IncFIB among transconjugants and the distribution of conjugation-positive isolates across different PFGE backgrounds support the coexistence of clonal dissemination and horizontal resistance transfer in the local CRKP population.
items.authors: Cihat Öztürk, Özlem Ünaldi, Zekiye Bakkaloğlu, Fatma Filiz Coşkun-Ari, Elif Sevim

items.title: Association of Age-Related Macular Degeneration and Dementia: A Health Registry Database Study
items.abstract: Objectives: Dementia and age-related macular degeneration (AMD) share common neurodegenerative risk factors. We examined the association between AMD and dementia. Methods and Analysis: This was a retrospective cohort study using an aggregated electronic health records network. Patients with AMD were matched 1:1 to pseudophakic controls without AMD or prior dementia using propensity score matching (PSM) for demographics and comorbidities. Outcomes included the development of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Parkinson’s disease (PD), vascular dementia, and unspecified dementia, compared using relative risk (RR). Results: After PSM, 64,160 patients were included in each cohort. Rates of AD (1.19% vs. 1.19%, p = 0.92 at 5 years; 1.28% vs. 1.24%, p = 0.50 at 10 years), PD (0.54% vs. 0.52%, p = 0.76; 0.57% vs. 0.55%, p = 0.55), and vascular dementia (0.60% vs. 0.54%, p = 0.15; 0.65% vs. 0.57%, p = 0.08) were similar between cohorts. A modest increase in unspecified dementia was observed in the AMD cohort at 5 (3.07% vs. 2.84%, p = 0.02) and 10 years (3.30% vs. 3.01%, p 0.01). Conclusions: Utilizing a large healthcare database, AMD was not associated with development of AD, PD, or vascular dementia compared to a matched pseudophakic control population. A small increase in unspecified dementia and aggregate neurodegenerative outcomes was observed in the AMD cohort; however, given the nonspecific nature of this diagnosis, this finding requires cautious interpretation. Further prospective studies are necessary to definitively establish a relationship between AMD and dementia.
items.authors: Karen M. Wai, Hasitha Nimmagadda, Euna Koo, Ehsan Rahimy, Prithvi Mruthyunjaya

items.title: Well Orientation Effects on Hydraulic Fracturing in Tight Sandstone: A True Triaxial Experimental Study
items.abstract: To clarify the controlling effects of the well deviation angle and azimuth angle on the breakdown pressure, propagation morphology, and fracture-network complexity of hydraulic fractures in tight sandstone, true triaxial hydraulic fracturing physical simulations were systematically conducted on Chang 7 Member sandstone from Yanchuan County, Ordos Basin, under different well deviation and azimuth angles. By combining injection-pressure monitoring, surface fracture-morphology observation, and three-dimensional laser scanning, the breakdown pressure, propagation path, surface roughness, fractal dimension, and overall complexity of the fractures were quantitatively analyzed. The results show that, at an azimuth angle of 90°, the breakdown pressure of the sandstone generally decreases as the well deviation angle increases from 0° to 90°, dropping from 19.125 MPa to 13.569 MPa, indicating that horizontal wells are easier to fracture. At a well deviation of 60°, the fracture is more prone to deflect and communicate with natural weak planes, yielding the highest overall complexity (f = 1.629). For horizontal wells under normal-faulting stress, the breakdown pressure decreases as the azimuth angle increases; the lowest breakdown pressure (12.933 MPa) is obtained when the wellbore is drilled along the maximum horizontal principal stress (σH), and the highest (18.310 MPa) when parallel to the minimum horizontal principal stress (σh). When the azimuth angle is 30°, both the fracture-surface roughness (Sa = 2.037 mm, Sq = 2.691 mm) and the overall complexity (f = 1.679) reach their maxima, which is most favorable for forming tortuous, rough, and complex fracture networks. The fractal dimension of the fractures varies little across the tested conditions (2.0339–2.1379), indicating that it is mainly controlled by the intrinsic heterogeneity of the rock. The research results can provide an experimental basis for the optimization of horizontal-well trajectories and fracturing-parameter design in tight sandstone reservoirs.
items.authors: Rui Chang, Kai Xu, Hao Chen, Biao Feng, Yilin Ren, Wanwan Miao

items.title: Tea Tree Oil as an Oxygenated Diesel Blend Fuel: Chemical Characterisation, Droplet Combustion, Performance and Emission Analysis
items.abstract: Depleting fossil reserves and tightening emission limits have driven interest in plant-derived diesel blend fuels. This work evaluates tea tree oil (Melaleuca alternifolia) at 5, 10, 15 and 20 vol% in diesel through GC–MS characterisation, suspended-droplet combustion and single-cylinder engine testing. GC–MS resolved between 182 and 204 peaks per sample; eight monoterpene constituents were tracked, of which terpinen-4-ol was the largest peak in the neat oil at 21.81 area %. The oxygenated fraction rose from 19.07 to 20.85 area % between TTD5 and TTD20, raising fuel-bound oxygen from approximately 0.28 to 1.13% by weight, while the derived cetane number of the blends fell from 43.2 to 36.6. Droplet tests produced stable cone-shaped flames with ignition delays of 2–3 s and burn durations of 4–6 s, with micro-explosive burning from TTD10 onwards attributed to the volatility differential between the terpene and diesel fractions. In the engine, the longer ignition delay displaced combustion later in the cycle: CA10 referenced to injection rose from 8.7° for neat diesel to 18.4–20.5° for the blends, peak net heat release from 59.9 to 94.7 J/°CA and peak cylinder pressure from 72 to 88.7 bar, while the CA10–CA90 duration remained constant at 27–30 °CA. Brake thermal efficiency rose from 28.9 to 30.1% at full load and by 2.6 percentage points at part load. Brake-specific CO and hydrocarbons fell by 30.5 and 27.8%, and smoke by 24%, while NOx rose by 17.4%. A normalised multi-criteria assessment identified TTD15 as the preferred blend.
items.authors: Jerome Stanley Martin

items.title: Fabrication Routes, Microstructural Evolution, and Creep Performance of Oxide Dispersion Strengthened Austenitic Steels: A Review
items.abstract: Oxide dispersion strengthened (ODS) austenitic steels exhibit superior high-temperature stability and mechanical properties, which are attributed to the strong pinning effect of nano-oxide particles on dislocations and grain boundaries. The microstructure and properties of ODS steels are intrinsically governed by their fabrication techniques. While powder metallurgy (PM) serves as the predominant synthesis route, the fabrication of austenitic ODS steels faces distinct technical challenges compared to their ferritic counterparts, primarily due to issues such as powder sticking to the milling media. Conversely, although traditional melting processes often lead to oxide agglomeration, coarsening, or flotation, which makes it difficult to achieve a uniform dispersion, they remain of significant interest because of their scalability and cost-effectiveness. Furthermore, emerging technologies such as additive manufacturing (AM) have also been employed for the preparation of ODS steels. This review provides a systematic and comprehensive overview of the recent progress in the fabrication technologies of ODS austenitic steels. The scope encompasses a critical analysis of the merits and limitations of techniques including PM, in situ internal oxidation, melting, and AM, alongside an examination of the potential impacts of adding process control agents (PCA) to mitigate powder sticking during mechanical alloying. Additionally, the microstructural characteristics resulting from different processing routes are discussed in detail, followed by a consolidated evaluation of their mechanical properties.
items.authors: Yongbin Wang, Chenxin Yin, Zhangjian Zhou, Wenyue Zheng, Zhi Tong, Jinbao Wang

items.title: Anemia and Its Associated Factors Among Children Aged 6–59 Months After Internal Displacement in Central Sudan: A Cross-Sectional Study
items.abstract: Background: The ongoing conflict in Sudan has caused internal displacement. While pre-war baselines have been established, a critical gap remains in the literature on pediatric health in post-conflict reclaimed urban centers. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of anemia and identify its associated factors among children aged 6–59 months in Singa, Central Sudan. Methods: A community-based, multistage stratified cross-sectional study was conducted in Singa, Central Sudan, between August and September 2025. Sociodemographic characteristics were collected through face-to-face interviews. Anemia was defined according to the 2024 WHO age-specific hemoglobin criteria. Multivariable binary logistic regression analysis was performed. Results: A total of 450 children aged 6–59 months were included in the study. The median age was 23.5 months (interquartile range [IQR]: 13.0–38.0), and 252 (56.0%) were male. Most children were delivered vaginally (65.6%), had mothers with at least secondary education (53.1%), and were completely immunized (76.7%). The prevalence of anemia was 74.4% (95% confidence interval [CI] = 70.4–78.4%). In the univariable binary logistic regression analysis, younger age, smaller family size, younger maternal age, lower body weight, and a recent history of diarrhea were associated with anemia. After adjustment for potential confounders, while maternal age was inversely associated with anemia (adjusted odds ratio (aOR) = 0.95, 95% CI: 0.92–0.99) a recent history of diarrhea (aOR = 1.97, 95% CI: 1.22–3.17) was positively associated with anemia. The multivariable model demonstrated good calibration (Hosmer–Lemeshow p = 0.177). Conclusions: Anemia is a major public health concern among children aged 6–59 months returning to post-displacement settings. Anemia is primarily driven by younger maternal age and recent acute infectious diarrhea. Integrated strategies focusing on maternal education and support, diarrhea prevention and management, and early identification of at-risk children are needed to reduce the burden of anemia in this population.
items.authors: Hatim G. Altahir, Mohammad Alhasoon, Ebtihal E. Eltyeb, Abdullah Al-Nafeesah, Ashwaq AlEed, Ishag Adam

items.title: Emotional Expressive Flexibility and Mental Health: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: The relationship between expressive flexibility—the capacity to enhance and suppress visible emotional responses according to situational demands—and mental health has not been systematically synthesized. This systematic review examined associations across psychopathology, psychological well-being, resilience and adaptive functioning, and social functioning. Methods: Following preregistration on the Open Science Framework (10.17605/OSF.IO/BA5HD), PsycINFO, PsycArticles, and PubMed were searched on 23 June 2026, supplemented by citation searching and expert consultation. English-language, peer-reviewed studies of participants aged at least 12 years assessing expressive flexibility and mental health were eligible. Two reviewers independently selected studies and assessed methodological quality using design-specific JBI critical appraisal tools. Narrative synthesis, random-effects meta-analyses, and a structured narrative appraisal of the evidence for each outcome were conducted. Results: Twenty-nine studies were included (cumulative analytic sample: N = 8357). Appraisals identified limitations in confounding control, handling of incomplete follow-up, and methodological reporting. Greater overall expressive flexibility was generally associated with lower psychopathological symptom burden, greater psychological well-being, greater resilience and adaptive functioning, and better social functioning. Component findings varied. Pooled associations were inverse for depressive symptoms (k = 9, N = 3622, r = −0.14, 95% CI [−0.26, −0.01]) and, exploratorily, anxiety (k = 7, N = 3134, r = −0.13, 95% CI [−0.23, −0.03]). The positive association with life satisfaction was preliminary (k = 4, N = 1910, r = 0.27, 95% CI [0.02, 0.49]). Leave-one-out analyses indicated uncertainty across all three syntheses. Heterogeneity was substantial to very high and all prediction intervals included zero. Conclusions: Findings suggest that expressive flexibility is an emotion-expression capacity associated with several dimensions of mental health, primarily in non-clinical samples. Its potential transdiagnostic relevance warrants further investigation, but limited robustness, substantial heterogeneity, and predominantly cross-sectional evidence preclude firm conclusions about generalizability and causal effects.
items.authors: Dirk W. Eilert, Philipp Mensah

items.title: Optimization of Cr(VI) Photoreduction in Water over Ag-Promoted Nb2O5: Effects of Operating Conditions and Reactive Species
items.abstract: Photocatalytic reduction of Cr(VI) using Nb2O5-based catalysts has been reported; however, Ag-promoted Nb2O5 remains scarcely explored. In this context, the present study describes the performance of Ag/Nb2O5 catalysts in removing Cr6+ under various experimental conditions. The catalyst was studied, maintaining the nominal metallic load of 5% Ag. To optimize the process, the following operating conditions were analyzed: pH, catalyst concentration, calcination temperature, additive, air bubbling, photolysis, and additive (hole scavenger). The results obtained indicated that the 5%Ag/Nb2O5 catalyst achieves a higher photoreduction rate than bare Nb2O5. Optimization of process parameters showed that the scavenger inhibits chromium adsorption on the catalytic surface. Optimal conditions observed in the tests were as follows: solution pH of 2, with hole scavenger addition, in the absence of oxygen, using a catalyst concentration of 1 g L−1, and a calcination temperature of 300 °C (resulting in a poorly crystalline Nb2O5 phase). Photolysis in the presence of sodium formate reduced Cr6+; however, the reduction was slower. In the quenching tests, the radical scavengers that most influenced the reduction of Cr6+ were silver nitrate (e− scavenger) and oxalate (h+ scavenger). Oxalate was the only one to reduce the total chromium concentration in the solution.
items.authors: A. K. G. dos Santos, M. E. K. Fuziki, F. H. S. S. Pinheiro, M. M. Menechelli, A. L. W. Araujo, D. T. Dias

items.title: Fractionation of Lignocellulose in a Pressurized Ammonia Mixed Solvent System
items.abstract: Lignocellulose represents an abundant and renewable biomass feedstock; however, its intrinsically recalcitrant cross-linked network of cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin poses a significant barrier to the efficient fractionation and high-value utilization of its individual components. In response to this challenge, this study established a pressurized ammonia–solvent system for lignocellulosic component separation. Single-factor exploratory experiments were performed to probe general trends of key operational parameters including reaction temperature, system pressure, and solvent composition. Among the tested ranges, the preferable conditions were identified as follows: 50 vol% ethanol aqueous solution, a reaction temperature of 200 °C, a holding time of 6 h, and an ammonia pressure of 8 MPa. Under these selected operating parameters, the cellulose purity in the cellulose-enriched fraction reached 89.6 ± 1.4% with a cellulose recovery of 85.0 ± 2.1%.
